post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP. Issues access + refresh tokens for existing active users, or a short-lived REGISTER-scoped token for new users.
Sends a 6-digit OTP to an Indian mobile number. Always returns the same response regardless of whether the phone is registered.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh pair (rotation).

Requires a single-use registrationToken (scope REGISTER). Phone comes strictly from the token. Creates the Gym (14-day TRIAL, default plans, default trainer types) and the OWNER user (ACTIVE) in one transaction, then returns accessToken, refreshToken, and user.
